newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bousteadco in winning S$120 mln land bid.
newsitem.headline: Bousteadco in winning S$120 mln land bid.

text.p: Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Wednesday trading company Bousteadco Singapore Ltd was among a group of companies that won a tender for a parcel of land in Singapore.
The URA said in a statement Bousteadco, Goldman Financial Ltd and International Factors Leasing Pte Ltd bid Singapore $120 million for the 54,126 sq metre site.
SSL Properties Pte Ltd, a unit of Straits Steamship Land Co, came second in the tender, bidding S$90.61 million.

In a separate tender, the URA said Sin Soon Lee Realty Co Pte Ltd won a tender for a 153,602 sq metre site with a bid of S$238.89 million. Another tender, for a 54,126 sq metre plot, was won by Chng Gim Huat and Chng Heng Tiu for S$113.8 million.
The URA said all three sites were for the development of light, clean industries. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703199)
